task: Equal-bar T; two hexapods; T -> goal -> robots; random global yaw and target +/-5..30deg; fixed 40s duration
initialization: Random actor and critic; online reward-only TorchRL MAPPO; frozen original walking model only; no parent transport checkpoint, teacher actions, demonstration loss or external cargo force

training.algorithm: TorchRL MAPPO; shared local actor, central critic, per-agent ratios
training.reset_rng: torch CUDA; uniform reset ranges match native MuJoCo

learning_time.hardware: Local shared NVIDIA RTX A6000; not a hosted Colab/T4 measurement

protocol.selection: Last checkpoint at the fixed 3,145,728-team-step budget; algorithm/settings selected on development seeds only before final test.
protocol.film_selection: A successful development seed with zero body contact, both robots leg/foot cargo impulses positive; never used as a teacher.
protocol.paired_reward_trial: Orientation-error coefficient 4 trial was launched before final evaluation with equal initialization and a fixed equal 3,145,728-step budget; evaluated after completion; never used to change the selected baseline after final tests.

learned_warp.reset_cases: Native NumPy reset sampled separately for each identical CPU test seed; physical state copied only at reset

illustrations.selection: Selected successful development episodes, not independent performance estimates or learning data
illustrations.rendering: Actual 25 Hz native MuJoCo control states; no interpolation or frame duplication

limitations: One training seed; repeat at least three for a thesis
14/50 native episodes have some body contact; main cargo contact impulses are leg/foot, and the two illustrated episodes have no body contact
Simple forward/feedback comparisons do not establish superiority over an optimized rule-based navigation controller
Native and Warp have the same success count but can succeed on different episodes
The task/settings were tuned with multiple development runs; 30min is the selected fresh run, not the entire development effort

training.algorithm: TorchRL MAPPO; shared local actor, central critic, per-agent ratios
training.reset_rng: torch CUDA; uniform reset ranges match native MuJoCo

published_source_notes: The trained run explicitly sets cargo command limits to (0.2,0.2,0.6); these are now the API default.
VelocityDistribution.log_prob now rejects off-grid commands; probabilities of every sampled training command are unchanged.
